items.title: IREN stock soars, driven by massive gains in AI cloud sales
items.summary:
IREN Ltd. (IREN) stock is surging higher after reporting that its AI cloud sales have doubled since last quarter.

Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick and AInvest managing editor Adam Shapiro join Pras Subramanian to discuss IREN's post-earnings stock moves.

items.title: IREN Soars 19% as AI Cloud Revenue Nearly Triples, $4 Billion ARR “Fully Contracted and Fully Funded”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysIREN jumped 19% after AI Cloud revenue rose 182% from the June quarter to $200 million. Its target of more than $4 billion in annualized revenue slipped to January at Microsoft’s request, but IREN says it’s still fully contracted and funded.

items.title: Magnificent Seven Lost $1 Trillion in Tech Rout. Here's How Much Each Plunged.
items.summary: Nvidia led the decline with a loss of more than $440 billion in market value as major U.S. indexes posted their worst session since April 2025.

items.title: Not One Analyst Rates Amazon a Sell. Is Wall Street Right?
items.summary: Nearly every analyst loves Amazon, yet Jim Cramer calls big tech a millstone and the spending keeps climbing. One number in the next earnings report could decide whether the crowded bullish consensus holds or cracks.
